name: March Hare
timbre: falsely warm, rounded, slightly breathy man's voice with a lugubrious droop at phrase ends
pitch: mid baritone, noticeably lower and flatter than the Hatter
accent: mock-genteel Received Pronunciation laid over a country base, over-polite vowels
reference_style: Mock-courteous host whose manners are a weapon: clipped offers of things that aren't there, flat repetitions when cornered ('It was the best butter'), sudden yawns, whispered asides. A beat slower and gloomier than the Hatter so the pair never blur.
